verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU abakkiriza,
Bonna-abalina-ebibi:
Bwe bamusemberera,
Abakkiriza-ababi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu abakkiriza,
Bonn(a) abalin(a) ebibi:
Bwe bamusemberera,
Abakkiriz(a) ababi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Jjangu,nnaakuwummuza:
Kkiriza-ekigambo kye:
Eyasinga-okwonoona.
Mukama toomugobe

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yesu abakkiriza,
Bonn(a) abalin(a) ebibi:
Bwe bamusemberera,
Abakkiriz(a) ababi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Neeraba mu maaso go,
Bwe ndi-omwonoonyi ddala;
Naye bwe njija gy'oli
Sitya,ku lw'erinnya lyo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Yesu abakkiriza,
Bonn(a) abalin(a) ebibi:
Bwe bamusemberera,
Abakkiriz(a) ababi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Ka nkweyanze,Mukama,
Eyannyaniriza nze.
Nange-eyakujeemera
Gw'onaaza-omusaayi gwo.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Yesu abakkiriza,
Bonn(a) abalin(a) ebibi:
Bwe bamusemberera,
Abakkiriz(a) ababi.
